messages:
Lena (Partnerships): Azure asked for an evidence package for the new listing: SOC2 Type II cover page, latest pen-test redacted, vendor attestation, and the completed security questionnaire. Deadline = 10 days. Who can own collating?
Diego (Security): I can consolidate the pen-test and produce the redacted PDF. Need to confirm if they want a CSV of CVE IDs or a narrative.
Nora (Marketplace): They prefer a CVE list + short mitigation lines. Also require a machine-readable checklist.csv and a scope.txt listing products/regions.
Priya (Compliance): SOC2 cover page is fine — provide the PDF and the auditor letter. Also: add SOC scope statement and the period covered in scope.txt.
Erik (Eng): For redaction we should run the automated scrub then manual review. I'll schedule a reviewer. Also note: firmware tests from HardwareCo need export-control notes.
Lena (Partnerships): HardwareCo involvement: they ran a small on-device test last month. We need to state that firmware images were not included in the pen-test bundle and attach export control note.
Diego (Security): Action plan: 1) Request raw pen-test from vendor (vendor@pentest.example). 2) Run /opt/evidence/redact --rules marketplace. 3) Create findings.csv (cve,severity,mitigation). 4) Produce redwood_evidence_manifest.json (but we'll attach manifest.txt instead per marketplace rules).
Nora (Marketplace): Reminder: zip naming must follow pattern marketplace_azure_<listingid>_<YYYYMMDD>.zip and max 250MB. Put checksum.sha256 at top level.
Priya (Compliance): Attestation must be signed by vendor and by Redwood security lead. I'll provide the attestation language: scope + statement of redaction + statement of no customer data included.
Erik (Eng): Commands I'll run:
```
aws s3 cp raw/pentest_vendor_report.pdf s3://evidence/inbound/azure/HardwareCo-20260401.pdf
/opt/evidence/redact --input s3://evidence/inbound/... --output /tmp/redacted.pdf --rules marketplace
python tools/generate_findings.py /tmp/redacted.pdf --out findings.csv
zip -r marketplace_azure_listing789_20260408.zip redacted.pdf findings.csv attestation.pdf scope.txt checklist.csv checksum.sha256
aws s3 cp marketplace_azure_listing789_20260408.zip s3://evidence/outbound/azure/ --acl private
aws s3 presign s3://evidence/outbound/azure/marketplace_azure_listing789_20260408.zip --expires-in 864000
```
Diego (Security): Redaction checklist: remove emails, customer names, internal hostnames, screenshots with identifiable data, raw logs. Confirm hash after redaction and before zipping.
Lena (Partnerships): Who uploads to Azure portal? We can upload if given a portal account. Otherwise we send presign to Nora and she will upload.
Nora (Marketplace): I can upload once I have presign and the listing manager credentials. If we upload, include the short cover note in the portal comment field: "Redwood submission: SOC2 + pentest + attestation — contact partnerships@redwood.com"
Priya (Compliance): Keep copies in the compliance vault for 3 years. Add entries to the compliance tracker with vendor name, report date, sha256, and redaction stamp.
Lena (Partnerships): Action owners: Diego = vendor follow-up + redact. Erik = run redaction job + create presign. Priya = attestation language + compliance entry. Nora = portal upload or confirm presign upload. I'll send the external note after internal review.
evidence-bot: Created ticket EVID-5007 assigned to Diego, Erik, Priya, Nora.
Diego (Security): Vendor contact pinged: vendor@pentest.example — asked for raw PDF and CVE export.
Erik (Eng): Job queued: redact-job-20260402-02. Will post presign link here when available.
Nora (Marketplace): Noted timeline: draft by Wed EOD, review Thu, upload Fri. Ping me if blocked. :white_check_mark:
